'''0.20b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed various bugs with the [[0.20a]] update.

==Changelog==
* Fixed bugs when entering the game
* Fixed bug in the mechanics of changing jobs, causing the server to hang
* Fixed quest text for the Russian version
* Fixed bug in text for the English version
